translations.web: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?
translations.bsb: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and sky. Why don’t you know how to interpret the present time?
translations.kjv: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
translations.asv: Ye hypocrites, ye know how to interpret the face of the earth and the heaven; but how is it that ye know not how to interpret this time?
